def g79_collect_actual_rows_acc(plan,executionPath,activation=False):

    assert [x['id'] for x in execution['cells']]==[x['id'] for x in plan['cells']]
    rows=[]

        req=json.loads(read(cell['request']['path']));r=json.loads(read(cell['report']));guard=actual['guardian'];slot=plan['slot']
        assert r['status']=='PASS' and r['mode']=='js' and r['stopAfter']=='check' and r['checksExcluded']==r['outputPatches']==0 and r['acceptanceEvidence']is False
        assert r['requestSha256']==cell['request']['sha256']==g56_ref_acc(cell['request']['path'])['sha256']
        assert r['moduleCount']==17 and r['sourceDeclarations']==2954 and r['stepCounts']=={'expand':263032,'check':1975761}
        assert r['exports']==req['exports']==g79_protocol_acc['runtime']['ABIExports'] and r['limits']==g79_protocol_acc['limits'] and r['workerPolicy']==g79_protocol_acc['runtime']['workerPolicy']
        assert r['runtime']['versions']['node']=='23.11.0' and r['runtime']['versions']['v8']=='12.9.202.28-node.14' and r['runtime']['execArgv']==g79_protocol_acc['runtime']['execArgv'] and Path(r['runtime']['execPath']).resolve()==Path(g43_tools_acc['node']).resolve()
        assert [p['phase'] for p in r['phases']]==['startup','load-parse','expand','check'] and len(req['inputs'])==52 and all(g56_ref_acc(p)['sha256']==h for p,h in req['inputs'].items())
        assert all(g56_ref_acc(p)['sha256']==h for p,h in req['pins'].items()if p!=slot)
        a=actual['activation'];assert a['postPinsVerified']is True and a['active']['sha256']==a['post']['sha256']==cell['source']['sha256']==req['pins'][slot]
        assert req['image']==slot and r['source']==req['root'] and r['sourceSha256']==g56_ref_acc(req['root'])['sha256']
        assert guard['status']=='PASS' and guard['ownedTreeStopped'] and guard['timeoutMs']==600000 and guard['memoryLimitBytes']==guard['rssLimitBytes']==8589934592
        check=r['phases'][-1];row={k:cell[k]for k in ['id','sequence','role']};row.update({'request':cell['request'],'report':g56_ref_acc(cell['report']),'image':cell['source'],'activation':a,'checkerCpuMs':check['userCpuMs']+check['systemCpuMs'],'checkerWallMs':check['elapsedMs'],'footprintBytes':guard['peakFootprintBytes'],'rssBytes':guard['peakRssBytes'],'guardElapsedMs':guard['elapsedMs']})
        if activation:
            keys=['selectedGeneric','selectedElided','selectedFallback'];before=check['beforeCounters'];after=check['afterCounters'];final=r['g79Counters'];assert all(isinstance(x.get(k),int)and x[k]>=0 for x in [before,after,final]for k in keys)
            assert all(before[k]<=after[k]<=final[k]for k in keys);row['checkCounters']={k:after[k]-before[k]for k in keys};row['finalCounters']=final
        rows.append(row)
    return rows
